title: Groups and a deployment view: Shop on AWS
prompt: Model a Shop system with a Web App and an API container, both in a "Core" group. Add a Database container (technology PostgreSQL) in its own "Data" group. Then describe a Production deployment: the API and the Database both run on AWS, with the API sitting behind a Load Balancer infrastructure node. Add a `deployment` view for the Production environment. Run `structurizrx validate --strict` before you consider it done.
